ai_summary: Grasim Industries Limited will infuse approximately INR 2.35 billion (USD ~28.2 million) into its subsidiary, Aditya Birla Renewables Limited (ABReN), through a preferential issue of over 231 million equity shares at INR 10.15 each. This significant capital injection from the parent company aims to bolster ABReN's financial position, presumably to fund its renewable energy projects. No immediate red flags are apparent, as the issuance to the promoter via private placement is a standard internal funding mechanism based on a mutually agreed valuation.
